_comment: Panel colour presets (FM1-VST-PLAN.md 4.8), embedded in the plugin (plugin/Theme.cpp). base / membrane / knob are the three user-facing colours; bed (the recessed plate the keys and buttons sit in; a darker shade of the membrane when absent) and label (the printed labels; auto-contrast against the plate when absent) are optional overrides. Sampled as 7x7 medians from the product photos in reference/MVaveOfficialColors on 2026-10-07, then tuned by eye in phase 3: White/Blue and Purple take the bed from the button block (the key-bed samples were in shadow), Orange keeps the photo's white labels (3.4:1 on the plate); Purple's photo shows white labels too, but they reach only 2.4:1 on that lilac, under the 3.0 floor of tests/panel_render_test, so its labels are the automatic dark ones. A custom theme file in <fm1emu>/themes/*.json has the keys of one entry here. 'Emulator' is the ChoralRoot emulator's own palette (tools/emu/emu.c C_PLATE / C_CAP / C_BED / C_LABEL / the knob cap).

presets.name: Black
presets.note: the photo's body reads #646464 under studio light; the unit is near-black, so base is darkened to match the bed
